The camera roll & the reality

My two-day Short Inca Trail trip began with a 3 a.m. alarm and left me with 575 photographs to sort through. Enough for a small museum, or at least a long evening choosing favourites.

The views made it into the story, but so did the waiting around, the early alarms and a sunrise that stayed behind the clouds. Those details belong to the journey just as much as the photograph everyone recognises.
